entities.name: SasA sensory kinase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt B0JK50 from Microcystis aeruginosa; length 384 aa.
Adaptive-response sensory histidine kinase in the cyanobacterial SasA/RpaA clock-output pathway.
Autophosphorylates a conserved histidine and transfers phosphate to the response regulator RpaA.
Interacts with KaiC in the KaiABC circadian clock complex and recruits fold-shifted KaiB.
Predicted domains: KaiB-like PF07689 at residues 24-105, HisKA PF00512 at 156-224, and HATPase_c PF02518 at 274-382.

entities.name: RpaA response regulator
observations: Downstream response regulator receiving phosphate from SasA in cyanobacterial circadian clock output.

entities.name: KaiC clock protein
observations: Core cyanobacterial circadian oscillator component that interacts with SasA and enhances SasA autophosphorylation.

entities.name: Cyanobacterial circadian clock
observations: SasA/RpaA is a clock-output pathway regulating genome-wide circadian gene expression and adaptation to light/dark cycles.

entities.name: SasA histidine autophosphorylation
observations: ATP + protein L-histidine → ADP + protein N-phospho-L-histidine; EC 2.7.13.3 reference reaction.
